aliasDesc: Right-click a document in the tree to set one
nbDesc: Left switch = enable; right field = display name
unnamedDesc: Entries without a resolvable ID (e.g. "Untitled"). Count:
maskHeadingsDesc: Headings display the current document's alias (or the default name).
contentHint: Targets only the current document's body (paragraph/list/table..., excluding headings).
pickTitle: Choose body content to hide (current document)
pickEmpty: No selectable body blocks in the current document
pickHeadingTip: (headings are configured in Heading masking and excluded here)
passwordEnableLabel: Require a password to exit privacy mode
noEditLabel: Read-only: any click asks for the password
noEditHint: The page stays visible; you can also use Ctrl+Shift+X to start read-only.
idleUnit: minutes of inactivity before entering privacy mode (0 = off)
treeUnit: minutes after entering privacy mode to auto-collapse the left file tree (0 = off)
treeHint: Collapsing the file tree avoids revealing how many documents there are. Expanded again when privacy mode is off.
unlockDesc: Enter the password to exit privacy mode
blockHint: Privacy mode is locked, click to enter the password
placeholderDesc: Used for entries without an enabled alias
